system.description:
You can spend a Force Point as a Swift Action to designate one ally within 12 squares of you and in your line of sight that is currently Grabbed, Grappled, or Immobilized; that target automatically escapes from the Grab or Grapple (or the Immobilization effect is removed), and the target can move up to half its Speed immediately as a Reaction.

This movement does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

prerequisite.text: a member of The Aing-Tii Monks
